scope: Local fakes and pinned local helper bytes only
nativeControlOwnershipGate: Owned proof/controller/hash, admitted account/generations, exact selected fixture metadata and current playback file
foreignPlaybackCleanup: Refuse native close, preserve product state, retain unconfirmed cleanup status; remove only owned QA references
transitionControls: Maintain owned controls before the first frame regardless of Q2_GENERAL/Q3 status; skip temporarily occluded entry without input; abort changed ownership
failureMetadataPreservation: Preserve original failed read before stop, then capture fresh after metadata following owned native close and settled retirement while original proof/account references remain; record compact evidence before clearing

cua4SafeFailureAnalysis.interpretation: Controls remained hidden across the observed transition and sole paused frame. Instantaneous route/lossy/owner-current flags were not recorded in that frame; individual transition gates cannot be reconstructed uniquely. The actor waited until Q3 before reveal, missing the only paused RVFC.

preparedScreenshot.stage: After first qualified seek50 frame, while owned playback is paused
preparedScreenshot.preflight: New exact safe label filename; checked again immediately before capture
preparedScreenshot.privacyScope: Local full-screen pixels can contain UI text; no independent pixel redaction claim

limits: Inherited common33 startup and final transport cleanup retain their existing library deadlines; 30s is reserved beyond the actor cleanup deadline, not an independent cancellation mechanism for common33.
Native Runtime.evaluate promises have a finite host deadline but cannot cancel already dispatched page evaluation. Admission wrappers clear late owned self-registration after cleanup begins.
Physical mapping is pinned from prior device observation. Each input checks current viewport and quantized DOM hit geometry; this actor does not recalibrate from a new native screenshot.
Complete covers the existing bounded functional observer contract only; full duration quality, resources and performance remain separate.
